content: {"episode_id":"ep-05197","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-50 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for episode ep-05197. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat, which are concerning for arrhythmia in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency, supporting diagnosis codes I34.0 and R00.2. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptoms with potential cardiac events over an extended monitoring period, which addresses the payer's stated concern that documentation did not sufficiently establish the requirement for continuous ambulatory monitoring. We request reconsideration and payment of the outstanding balance of 709.25."}
